RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Aftershock Echo
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Within 6 seconds of a movement ability, the first spin hit releases a 3-cell shockwave: up to 4 enemies take 8 base secondary damage per stack. 4-second cooldown.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Mercy Arc
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Accumulate 20 actual healing on yourself or an ally to store one arc, capped at one. Your next basic hit chains to up to 2 other enemies within 8 cells of the target, dealing 8 base secondary damage per stack.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Shattered Fury
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: After an enemy breaks your shield, your next basic hit within 3 cells in the following 6 seconds deals 12 base secondary damage per stack. Natural shield expiry does not trigger this.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Ember Relay
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: When your summon hits a burning enemy, apply a burn for 2 base damage per stack each second, six times. 2-second cooldown per owner. Does not trigger owner basic-hit rewards.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Frost Circuit
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Basic hits against slowed or stunned enemies arc to up to 2 other enemies within 6 cells for 6 base secondary damage per stack. 3-second cooldown.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Bloodstep
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Within 6 seconds after a movement ability, your next damaging basic hit heals 6 ordinary injury points per stack. Once per movement.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Soul Lantern
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Personally killing an eligible or trial enemy with a basic attack grants 12 base shield per stack for 6 seconds. 3-second cooldown.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Tempered Reprisal
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Accumulate 20 shield damage absorbed from enemies to store one reprisal, capped at one. The first hit of your next ability deals 10 base secondary damage per stack.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Distant Spark
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Hitting an enemy at least 12 cells away with an ability primes your next basic hit within 6 seconds for 10 base secondary damage per stack. 3-second cooldown.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Shared Spring
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Accumulate 15 actual healing on other colonists to give yourself and the latest recipient 10 base shield per stack for 5 seconds. 4-second cooldown.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Cinder Return
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Accumulate 20 actual burn damage to store one return, capped at one. Your next basic hit heals 5 ordinary injury points per stack.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Twin Convergence
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Cast two different combat abilities within 6 seconds to prime your next basic hit. Strike up to 3 other enemies within 3 cells of the target for 7 base secondary damage per stack. Stores one charge.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Lone Blade
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: On a basic hit with no other player colonist within 6 cells, deal 18% of the actual hit as extra base damage, capped at 30.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Patient Hunter
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: After 5 seconds without a damaging basic hit, your next basic hit deals 30% of its actual damage as extra base damage, capped at 35. Secondary damage does not restart the timer.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Alternating Rhythm
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Alternating basic and ability hits deal 12% of actual hit damage as extra base damage, capped at 20. Consecutive hits of the same type gain nothing. 0.5-second cooldown.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Roaming Hunter
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Switching basic attacks to a different enemy deals 15% of actual hit damage as extra base damage, capped at 25. The first target grants no bonus. 1-second cooldown.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Close Quarters
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Basic hits within 3 cells deal 18% of actual damage as extra base damage, capped at 30. Basic attacks against more distant enemies deal 12% less damage before mitigation.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Field Medic
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: After actually healing another colonist for at least 1 point, your next basic hit within 6 seconds deals 20% of actual damage as extra base damage, capped at 30. Stores one charge.
